title: .claude/agents/os-dev.md says `os-dev-report` is the report comment's first line, but post-stamped.mjs refuses any body whose first line is not the seat signature
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Filing gate ①: two governed texts that contradict each other, with named locations. Reported by four devs in their reports. The latest, PR #27571's dev report 6498038778 OQ2, was escalated to this seat by contract review 6515518634 ③: "A governed-prose amendment on its own card for the devx seat". Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Filed without `domain:*`: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is a governed surface in the `domain:skills` lane, so triage routes it.
Business reason: a dev that follows `os-dev.md` literally writes `os-dev-report` as line 1, and the only sanctioned writer refuses that body. Each dev then stops, or asks the seat, or reports the conflict as a deviation. That costs a round-trip on every dispatch.
Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` lane.
Dedupe: `os-dev-report` together with `first line` / `signature` searched across open cards. None was found.

## Measured (`origin/main`)

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:17`: 「报告交付两次,GitHub 优先:同一段 JSON 先作 issue 评论,首行单独一行是纯文本 `os-dev-report`。」
- `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs:468`: "## The first line is the seat's signature, or the body is refused (#27113)". A body whose first line is not a signature is `EXIT_REFUSED` before any request. L476–477: "Every first-line recogniser skips one leading signature line (`stripSignatureLine`), so a signed record reads exactly as the unsigned one did."
- So the readers already accept the order signature, then `os-dev-report`. Only the agent file's prose says otherwise. Seat dispatch orders have been telling devs to put the signature on line 1 and `os-dev-report` on line 2, and the devs report each time that this conflicts with `os-dev.md`.

## Wanted

Amend `os-dev.md:17` (and any sibling line in that file) so the report comment is: line 1 the seat signature (as `post-stamped.mjs` writes it), then line 2 `os-dev-report`. Name `post-stamped.mjs` as the writer. ⛔ No change to the recognisers. They already strip one signature line.

## Acceptance

`os-dev.md` and `post-stamped.mjs` agree on the first two lines. The skill line ratchet and governed-prose pins stay green.
